KGD_BEKAL.desc: Kasaragod's coast in one easy day: the old Malik Dinar mosque, Chandragiri fort above the river mouth, the great keyhole walls of Bekal Fort and a sunset on Bekal beach.
KGD_BEKAL.itin:
8:00 AM — Pickup: Kasaragod railway station · Kasaragod KSRTC bus station · Kanhangad station (Kanhangad pickup from 7:15 AM)
8:30 AM — Malik Dinar Mosque, Thalangara: One of Kerala's oldest mosques, linked to Malik ibn Dinar; Thalangara is also known for its white prayer caps. (Modest dress · viewed respectfully)
9:30 AM — Chandragiri Fort & river: A 17th-century laterite fort on the hill where the Chandragiri river meets the sea. (Uneven ground)
11:00 AM — Bekal Fort: Kerala's largest fort: keyhole-shaped walls, an observation tower and the sea on three sides. Lunch nearby, own expense. (Entry own expense)
3:00 PM — Bekal Beach Park, Pallikere: Palm-shaded beach park beside the fort — a stroll, sea breeze and the sunset. (Swim only where flagged)
6:00 PM — Drop-off: Kasaragod, Kanhangad, or your own stop on the way
KGD_BEKAL.gtk:
🏰 Fort timings: Bekal Fort is protected by the ASI and listed as open daily, about 8 AM to 5:30 PM. Timings can change — we re-confirm the day before and adjust the order if needed.
🕌 Mosque visit: Shoulders, arms and knees covered; women carry a scarf for the head. We avoid Friday midday prayers and view the mosque respectfully from the grounds.
🌊 Beach safety: Sea bathing only where lifeguards allow; none at all in the monsoon (June–September). The fort walls have open edges — keep children close.
☀️ Heat: Bekal Fort has almost no shade by late morning. Carry a hat, water and sunscreen; the beach park has shade under the palms.
KGD_BEKAL.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
KGD_BEKAL.exc: Lunch; Fort and beach park entry; Tolls and parking (private trips)
KGD_BEKAL.carry: Hat and sunscreen; Clothes covering shoulders and knees; Scarf for the mosque; Cash for entry fees

KGD_RANIPURAM.desc: Kasaragod's 'Ooty': a forest trail through shola woods to the grassy top of Ranipuram on the Karnataka border, then Kanhangad's old Hosdurg Fort and the quiet caves of Nithyanandashram.
KGD_RANIPURAM.itin:
7:00 AM — Pickup: Kasaragod railway station · Kasaragod KSRTC bus station · Kanhangad station (Kanhangad pickup 7:45 AM)
9:30 AM — Ranipuram trek: About 2.5 km each way through shola forest to open meadows and views over the Kodagu hills. Allow 3 hours. (Forest ticket own expense)
1:00 PM — Lunch near Panathady: Simple Kerala meals at the base or in Rajapuram, own expense.
3:45 PM — Hosdurg Fort & Nithyanandashram: Kanhangad's round-bastioned Keladi fort, and the ashram's 45 rock-cut meditation caves next to it. (Quiet · modest dress)
6:30 PM — Drop-off: Kasaragod, Kanhangad, or your own stop on the way
KGD_RANIPURAM.gtk:
🥾 The trek: An easy-to-moderate path with some steep, slippery patches — fine for most fit adults and older children. No shops on the trail or at the top; carry water and a snack.
🐘 Forest rules: The forest department checks the trail every morning and may pause trekking if elephants are near. Stay on the path, keep together and follow the forest staff.
🌧️ Season: Greenest from June to January; mist and leeches in the monsoon. If the trail is closed for weather or elephants, we tell you early and offer another date.
🚯 Plastic-free: Disposable plastic is not allowed inside; bottles may be checked at the counter. Bring a reusable bottle; we carry all rubbish back.
KGD_RANIPURAM.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
KGD_RANIPURAM.exc: Breakfast and lunch; Forest trek ticket; Tolls and parking (private trips)
KGD_RANIPURAM.carry: Shoes with good grip; Raincoat or light jacket; Salt & socks (leeches); Cash for tickets

KGD_VALIYAPARAMBA.desc: North Malabar's quiet backwaters: a cruise past islands, mangroves and fishing villages on the Thejaswini, the old Nileshwar palace, and a walk where the rivers meet the sea.
KGD_VALIYAPARAMBA.itin:
8:00 AM — Pickup: Kasaragod railway station · Kasaragod KSRTC bus station · Kanhangad station (Kanhangad pickup 8:40 AM)
10:00 AM — Valiyaparamba backwater cruise: About 2.5 hours from the Kottappuram side past palm islands, mangroves and fishing villages. Lunch on board or in Nileshwar, own expense. (Boat paid direct)
2:30 PM — Nileshwar Palace: The two-storey palace of the Nileshwar Rajas, now a folklore centre of the Archaeology Department. (Check timings)
3:45 PM — Thaikadappuram estuary: The quiet fishing beach where the Thejaswini and Nileshwar rivers reach the sea. (No swimming)
6:00 PM — Drop-off: Kasaragod, Kanhangad, or your own stop on the way
KGD_VALIYAPARAMBA.gtk:
🛶 The boat: Licensed houseboats and motorboats run from the Kottappuram side; we book the slot, you pay the boat direct. Life jackets on for everyone, children included.
🌧️ Weather: Cruises can be cut short or cancelled in heavy rain or strong wind. If the boat can't run we tell you early and offer another date.
🏛️ Palace & beach: The palace is a protected building with set visiting hours — we re-confirm the day before. Thaikadappuram is a working fishing beach: no swimming, and keep clear of the boats.
☀️ Sun on the water: There is little shade on open decks around midday. Carry a hat, sunscreen and water.
KGD_VALIYAPARAMBA.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
KGD_VALIYAPARAMBA.exc: Boat cruise fare; Lunch; Any entry fees; Tolls and parking (private trips)
KGD_VALIYAPARAMBA.carry: Hat and sunscreen; Light clothes and sandals; Small towel; Cash for the boat

KGD_ANANTHAPURA.desc: Kasaragod's temple country: Madhur's copper-roofed temple, Ananthapura's lake temple and its crocodile, Posadi Gumpe's views and Kumbla's hill fort.
KGD_ANANTHAPURA.itin:
7:30 AM — Pickup: Kasaragod railway station · Kasaragod KSRTC bus station · Kanhangad station (Kanhangad pickup on request)
8:00 AM — Madhur Temple: The riverside Ganapathi–Shiva temple with a three-tiered copper roof and Ramayana carvings. (Temple dress code)
9:45 AM — Ananthapura Lake Temple: Kerala's only lake temple, home of Babiya the 'vegetarian' crocodile — and a new one since 2023. (Closes 12:30 PM)
11:30 AM — Posadi Gumpe: A rock hill near Paivalike: a moderate climb to views over the hills and sea. (Some climbing)
1:30 PM — Kumbla & Arikady Fort: Lunch in Kumbla, own expense, then the ruined 17th-century hill fort. (Free · uneven ground)
3:30 PM — Drop-off: Kasaragod, Kanhangad, or your own stop on the way
KGD_ANANTHAPURA.gtk:
🛕 Temple rules: Traditional dress: men may be asked to remove shirts; women in saree, churidar or long skirt. Temples follow their own customs on entry — we brief you on the way and respect the staff's word.
🐊 The crocodile: Sightings are never guaranteed — it is a wild animal living in the lake. Never feed it, throw things or lean over the water.
⏰ Morning temples: Both temples close around midday and reopen in the evening, so we visit them first. Festival days can bring big crowds — we adjust the order if needed.
⛰️ Posadi Gumpe: No shops or shade at the top; carry water and a hat. Shoes with grip — the rock is slippery after rain.
KGD_ANANTHAPURA.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
KGD_ANANTHAPURA.exc: Lunch; Temple offerings; Tolls and parking (private trips)
KGD_ANANTHAPURA.carry: Traditional / modest clothes; Shoes with grip; Hat and water; Cash for offerings

KGD_IXE.desc: Mangaluru is Kasaragod's nearest airport. We pick you up at your door, cross the Talapady border into Karnataka with the papers ready and drop you at departures — or meet you at arrivals.
KGD_IXE.itin:
Pickup — Your door: Home or hotel in Kasaragod town, Vidyanagar, Kumbla, Uppala or nearby — at the time we agree for your flight.
On the road — ~65 km via Talapady: About 1.5–2 hours on NH 66 through Kumbla, Uppala and Manjeshwar, across the Talapady border, then through Mangaluru to Bajpe. (Interstate permit arranged by us)
Drop-off — Mangaluru International Airport: Departures kerb at Bajpe. Reverse trips start from the arrivals exit. (No waiting charges on arrivals)
KGD_IXE.gtk:
✈️ Timing your trip: Leave about 4 hours before an international flight and 3 hours before a domestic one. Thokkottu, Pumpwell and the city roads to Bajpe jam at peak hours — we plan around them.
🛂 Border crossing: The trip enters Karnataka at Talapady; the interstate permit and border tax are billed at actual cost. Keep a photo ID handy in case of a check at the border.
🧳 Luggage: Gulf flights mean big bags: choose an MPV, Premium SUV or Traveller for families. Hatchbacks and sedans suit 2–3 people with check-in bags.
🔁 Landing at Mangaluru?: Share your flight number; we track delays and meet you at the arrivals exit with a name board. We track your flight — no waiting charges if it lands late.
KGD_IXE.inc: Door-to-door pickup; No waiting charges on arrivals; Driver bata; Fuel and per-km charges
KGD_IXE.exc: Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals; Meals on the way
KGD_IXE.carry: Passport / ID and tickets; Flight number shared with us; Photo ID for the border; Water for the drive

KGD_CNN.desc: Flying from Kannur International at Mattannur? We pick you up at your door anywhere in Kasaragod or Kanhangad and drop you at the terminal — or meet you at arrivals and bring you home.
KGD_CNN.itin:
Pickup — Your door: Home or hotel in Kasaragod, Kanhangad, Nileshwar or nearby — at the time we agree for your flight.
On the road — ~112 km via Taliparamba: About 2.5–3 hours on NH 66 via Kanhangad, Nileshwar and Payyanur to Taliparamba, then inland through Mayyil to Mattannur.
Drop-off — Kannur International Airport: Departures kerb at Mattannur. Reverse trips start from the arrivals exit. (No waiting charges on arrivals)
KGD_CNN.gtk:
✈️ Timing your trip: Leave about 6 hours before an international flight and 5 hours before a domestic one. NH 66 widening around Kanhangad, Nileshwar and Payyanur can slow traffic — we plan around it.
🛫 At the airport: Kannur airport has one terminal building for domestic and international flights. Tell us your flight and we drop you at the right departures door.
🧳 Luggage: Gulf flights mean big bags: choose an MPV, Premium SUV or Traveller for families. Hatchbacks and sedans suit 2–3 people with check-in bags.
🔁 Landing at Kannur?: Share your flight number; we track delays and meet you at the arrivals exit with a name board. We track your flight — no waiting charges if it lands late.
KGD_CNN.inc: Door-to-door pickup; No waiting charges on arrivals; Driver bata; Fuel and per-km charges
KGD_CNN.exc: Tolls and airport parking; Meals on the way
KGD_CNN.carry: Passport / ID and tickets; Flight number shared with us; Web check-in done; Water for the drive

KGD_COORG.desc: Up the Sampaje ghat into Karnataka's coffee country: Abbey Falls, the Tibetan Golden Temple, a Raja's Seat sunset and Dubare's elephants — two days with your own vehicle and driver.
KGD_COORG.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Pickup & drive to Coorg: From your door in Kasaragod — about 115 km via Mulleria, Sullia and the Sampaje ghat, roughly 3.5 hours with breakfast. (Stay booked by you)
Day 1 · 10:00 AM — Abbey Falls: A short walk down through coffee and spice estates to the falls near Madikeri. (Entry own expense · no bathing)
Day 1 · afternoon — Golden Temple, Bylakuppe: The great Namdroling monastery in the Tibetan settlement; Tibetan lunch nearby. (Shoes off · quiet inside)
Day 1 · sunset — Raja's Seat: The Kodava kings' garden lookout over misty hills. Overnight in Madikeri. (Entry own expense)
Day 2 · 8:30 AM — Dubare Elephant Camp: Watch the camp elephants bathe and feed by the Kaveri — reached by boat. (Mornings only · paid direct)
Day 2 · noon — Drive home: About 145 km back via Madikeri, Sampaje and Sullia; at your door in Kasaragod by evening.
KGD_COORG.gtk:
🐘 Dubare & the seasons: Elephant activities run only in the morning; the boat crossing can stop when the river is high. Falls and the ghat road are slippery in the monsoon (June–September).
🛕 Monastery etiquette: Golden Temple: shoes off and quiet inside; follow the signs on photos. Dress modestly — shoulders and knees covered.
🪪 Karnataka entry: Coorg is in Karnataka: interstate permit, border tax and tolls are billed at actual cost. We re-check entry rules before you travel.
🏨 Your stay: You book one night in or near Madikeri — coffee-estate homestays are a Coorg favourite. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
KGD_COORG.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; All Coorg sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
KGD_COORG.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Entry, elephant camp and boat fees; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
KGD_COORG.carry: Light jacket and raincoat; Photo ID; Comfortable walking shoes; Cash for entry fees

KGD_MOOKAMBIKA.desc: Kollur's Mookambika Devi temple, a forest-jeep ride up Kodachadri and Maravanthe beach on the way home — two days with your own vehicle and driver.
KGD_MOOKAMBIKA.itin:
Day 1 · 5:30 AM — Pickup & drive to Kollur: From your door in Kasaragod — about 185 km via Mangaluru, Udupi and Kundapura, roughly 4.5 hours with breakfast. (Stay booked by you)
Day 1 · 10:30 AM — Kollur Mookambika Temple: Darshan at the Devi temple below the Kodachadri hills; lunch nearby. (Modest traditional dress)
Day 1 · 1:00 PM — Kodachadri by forest jeep: A bumpy 1.5-hour jeep ride up, a walk to Sarvajna Peetha on the summit. Overnight in Kollur. (Jeep & permit paid direct)
Day 2 · 9:00 AM — Maravanthe Beach: The highway between the sea and the Souparnika river — a famous photo stop. (Rough sea · no swimming)
Day 2 · 10:00 AM — Kumbashi Anegudde: The hilltop Vinayaka temple near Kundapura, right on the way home. (Temple dress code)
Day 2 · 11:00 AM — Drive home: About 140 km back on NH 66 via Udupi and Mangaluru; at your door in Kasaragod by late afternoon.
KGD_MOOKAMBIKA.gtk:
🛕 Temple dress: Modest traditional dress: dhoti or trousers for men, saree or churidar for women; no shorts. Karnataka temples are tightening dress codes — we confirm before you go.
⛰️ Kodachadri jeep: Cars can't go to the top — permit jeeps leave Kollur; the last one goes up in the early afternoon. Rough mud track: not for back trouble or pregnancy. Usually stopped in heavy monsoon.
🪪 Karnataka entry: Kollur is in Karnataka: interstate permit, border tax and tolls are billed at actual cost. We re-check entry rules before you travel.
🏨 Your stay: You book one night in Kollur — temple lodges fill up on weekends and festivals. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
KGD_MOOKAMBIKA.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; All sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
KGD_MOOKAMBIKA.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Kodachadri jeep, permit and pooja fees; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
KGD_MOOKAMBIKA.carry: Traditional clothes for temples; Photo ID; Walking shoes & raincoat; Cash for the jeep and offerings

KGD_UDUPI.desc: Up the Karnataka coast: Udupi's Krishna temple, Malpe and St Mary's Island, Maravanthe beach and a sunset beneath Murudeshwar's giant Shiva — your own vehicle and driver.
KGD_UDUPI.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Pickup & drive to Udupi: From your door in Kasaragod — about 110 km on NH 66 via Mangaluru, roughly 3 hours with breakfast. (Stay booked by you)
Day 1 · 9:00 AM — Udupi Sri Krishna Matha: Darshan through the Kanakana Kindi window, then Car Street and its old temples. (Men shirtless · no jeans)
Day 1 · 11:00 AM — Malpe Beach & St Mary's Island: Malpe's long beach and, in season, a boat to the basalt-column island. Lunch in Udupi. (Island Oct–May · paid direct)
Day 1 · 3:30 PM — Maravanthe & Murudeshwar: A photo stop where the highway meets the sea, then sunset beneath the giant Shiva. Overnight here. (Temple dress code)
Day 2 · 7:30 AM — Murudeshwar Temple & tower: Morning darshan and the lift up the 20-storey gopura for sea views. (Lift ticket own expense)
Day 2 · 10:00 AM — Drive home: About 210 km back on NH 66 with a stop at Kaup lighthouse beach; home by evening.
KGD_UDUPI.gtk:
🛕 Temple dress codes: Udupi: men remove shirts; no jeans, T-shirts, shorts or sleeveless for anyone. Murudeshwar: men in dhoti or full-length trousers, women in saree or churidar.
🏝️ St Mary's Island: Boats run only in the dry season (about October–May) and stop on rough-sea days. No swimming at the island; wear sandals for the rocks.
🪪 Karnataka entry: Udupi is in Karnataka: interstate permit, border tax and tolls are billed at actual cost. We re-check entry rules before you travel.
🏨 Your stay: You book one night in Murudeshwar — sea-view rooms fill up on weekends. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
KGD_UDUPI.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; All sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
KGD_UDUPI.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Boat, lift and entry fees; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
KGD_UDUPI.carry: Traditional wear for temples; Photo ID; Hat and sunscreen; Cash for boats and offerings

KGD_GOKARNA.desc: Up the coast past Murudeshwar to Gokarna: the Mahabaleshwar temple, Om and Kudle beaches, the black peaks of Yana and Mirjan's river fort — your own vehicle and driver.
KGD_GOKARNA.itin:
Day 1 · 5:30 AM — Pickup & drive north: From your door in Kasaragod — about 285 km up the coast on NH 66 via Mangaluru, Udupi and Bhatkal. (Stay booked by you)
Day 1 · 11:00 AM — Murudeshwar on the way: The giant Shiva statue and temple tower by the sea; lunch here. (Temple dress code)
Day 1 · evening — Gokarna town beach: Check in, then sunset on the beach behind the temple street.
Day 2 · 8:00 AM — Yana Rocks & Mirjan Fort: Two huge black rock peaks in the forest, then a moss-covered laterite fort by the Aghanashini river. (Walk & steps · entry own expense)
Day 2 · afternoon — Kudle & Om Beach: Gokarna's famous cove beaches; walk the cliff path or take a boat to Half Moon. (Boats paid direct)
Day 3 · 6:30 AM — Mahabaleshwar Temple: Early darshan at the Atmalinga shrine before the crowds. (Men in dhoti, shirtless)
Day 3 · 8:00 AM — Drive home: About 285 km back down the coast; at your door in Kasaragod by evening.
KGD_GOKARNA.gtk:
🛕 Temple dress: Gokarna: men in dhoti only, shirts off; women in saree or churidar, no jeans. Murudeshwar: men in dhoti or full-length trousers, women in saree or churidar.
🌊 Beaches & boats: Currents are strong — swim only where lifeguards allow, never in the monsoon. Boats to Half Moon and Paradise beach are paid direct and stop in rough sea.
🪪 Karnataka entry: Gokarna is in Karnataka: interstate permit, border tax and tolls are billed at actual cost. We re-check entry rules before you travel.
🏨 Your stays: You book two nights in Gokarna — town guest houses or resorts near Om and Kudle. Your driver's night allowances are in our price.
KGD_GOKARNA.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 3 days; All Gokarna sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowances; No waiting charges
KGD_GOKARNA.exc: Your hotels; Meals; Entry, boat and lift fees; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
KGD_GOKARNA.carry: Dhoti / traditional wear; Photo ID; Sandals and sunscreen; Cash for boats and entry

KGD_CHIKMAGALUR.desc: Over the Charmadi ghat to the hills where India's coffee story began: Mullayanagiri, Baba Budangiri, Jhari Falls and the Hoysala carvings of Belur — your own vehicle and driver.
KGD_CHIKMAGALUR.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Pickup & drive to Chikmagalur: From your door in Kasaragod — about 200 km via Mangaluru, Ujire and the Charmadi ghat, roughly 6 hours with breaks. (Stay booked by you)
Day 1 · evening — Hirekolale Lake: A quiet reservoir below the Mullayanagiri range — best at sunset.
Day 2 · 6:30 AM — Mullayanagiri: Karnataka's highest peak — a climb up steps to the summit temple. (Vehicle slots · may need booking)
Day 2 · late morning — Baba Budangiri & Jhari Falls: The hills where coffee first came to India, then a jeep down to Jhari Falls. (Jeep paid direct)
Day 3 · 7:30 AM — Belur Chennakeshava Temple: The finest Hoysala carvings, about 24 km from Chikmagalur. (Shoes off · guide optional)
Day 3 · 10:00 AM — Drive home: About 225 km back over the Charmadi ghat; at your door in Kasaragod by evening.
KGD_CHIKMAGALUR.gtk:
⛰️ Charmadi ghat: We cross the ghat in daylight. In heavy monsoon rain it can close for hours or days. If it shuts, we take the longer Shiradi–Sakleshpur road (adds about 2 hours).
🏔️ Mullayanagiri rules: Vehicles go up in morning and afternoon slots; online pre-booking is being introduced. Closed on red-alert days and during hill festivals — we check and swap days.
🪪 Karnataka entry: Chikmagalur is in Karnataka: interstate permit, border tax and tolls are billed at actual cost. We re-check entry rules before you travel.
🏨 Your stays: You book two nights in Chikmagalur town or a coffee-estate homestay. Your driver's night allowances are in our price.
KGD_CHIKMAGALUR.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 3 days; All Chikmagalur sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowances; No waiting charges
KGD_CHIKMAGALUR.exc: Your hotels; Meals; Entry, jeep and guide fees; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
KGD_CHIKMAGALUR.carry: Warm jacket; Photo ID; Shoes with good grip; Cash for jeeps and entry

KGD_WAYANAD.desc: Down the coast to Kannur and up the Periya ghat into Kerala's green north: Banasura's earth dam, Pookode's forest lake and Edakkal's ancient carvings — your own vehicle and driver.
KGD_WAYANAD.itin:
Day 1 · 5:30 AM — Pickup & drive to Wayanad: From your door in Kasaragod — about 170 km via Kannur, Kuthuparamba and the Periya ghat, roughly 4.5 hours with breakfast. (Stay booked by you)
Day 1 · 11:00 AM — Banasura Sagar Dam: India's largest earth dam, with green islands in the reservoir. (Entry & boating own expense)
Day 1 · afternoon — Pookode Lake: A forest lake near Vythiri with pedal boats. Overnight in Kalpetta or Vythiri. (Boating paid direct)
Day 2 · 9:00 AM — Edakkal Caves: A short, steep climb to caves with prehistoric rock carvings. (Closed Mondays · entry own expense)
Day 2 · 11:30 AM — Drive home: Back via Mananthavady, the Periya ghat and Kannur; at your door in Kasaragod by evening.
KGD_WAYANAD.gtk:
🪨 Edakkal Caves: Closed on Mondays — on a Sunday start we visit on Day 1 instead. The climb is steep: not ideal for elders or small children.
⛰️ The ghat road: We use the Periya (Nedumpoyil) ghat; it can be restricted after heavy rain. We cross it in daylight both ways.
🌧️ Seasonal spots: Boating and viewpoints can shut on rain-alert days; some spots cap daily visitors. We check on the day and swap stops.
🏨 Your stay: You book your resort or homestay; Kalpetta and Vythiri are central. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
KGD_WAYANAD.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; All Wayanad sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
KGD_WAYANAD.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Entry, boating and trek fees; Tolls and parking
KGD_WAYANAD.carry: Walking shoes; Raincoat; Light jacket; Cash for entry fees

KGD_VELANKANNI.desc: From Kasaragod to the Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health at Velankanni, with a full, unhurried day at the shrine.
KGD_VELANKANNI.itin:
Day 1 · 4:30 AM — Pickup: Kasaragod railway station · Kasaragod KSRTC bus station · Kanhangad station
Day 1 · 5:15 PM — Down the coast to Karur: NH 66 past Kannur and Kozhikode, then via Palakkad and Coimbatore. (Room booked by you)
Day 2 · 11:00 AM — Velankanni Basilica: Check in, then the shrine of Our Lady of Good Health and Our Lady's Tank. (Modest dress)
Day 2 · evening — Rosary & the beach: Evening rosary and candle prayers at the shrine; a walk on the beach. (No sea bathing)
Day 3 · full day — Mass & the Way of the Cross: Mass, Our Lady's path, Morning Star Church, the museum — then rest and prayer. (Malayalam Mass — re-confirm)
Day 4 · 7:00 AM — Drive to Palakkad: Back via Thanjavur, Trichy and Coimbatore; night in Palakkad. (Room booked by you)
Day 5 · 2:30 PM — Drop-off: Kasaragod, Kanhangad, or your own stop on the way
KGD_VELANKANNI.gtk:
⛪ At the Basilica: Dress modestly — shoulders and knees covered; footwear off where asked. Masses run all day in several languages, usually one in Malayalam — we re-confirm the time.
🌊 Beach & crowds: The sea at Velankanni is rough and drownings have been reported — no swimming. Keep children close; we fix a meeting point at the Basilica arch.
🕯️ At an easy pace: A full, unhurried day at the shrine — Mass, the Way of the Cross and evening rosary. Buy candles and offerings only at the shrine's own counters.
🛣️ Long drive & rooms: Breaks every 2–3 hours; no driving after 9 PM. You book rooms in Karur, Velankanni (2 nights) and Palakkad; we share a list of pilgrim lodges.
KGD_VELANKANNI.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Driver bata and night allowance; Caretaker for 10+ guests
KGD_VELANKANNI.exc: Your rooms; Meals; Offerings and museum entry; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
KGD_VELANKANNI.carry: Modest clothes for church; Photo ID; Your regular medicines; Cash for offerings and candles
